summary: Client one-frame event carrying the player's answer to a game message box (seen when the ready check of the level swap teleporter was answered; born together with ecl::ready_check::Show/HideMessageBoxRequestOneFrameComponent and eoc::ready_check::*). Created by the per-frame update of ecl::UIManagerProxySystem from its queue of 8-byte responses; read by ecl::multiplayer::DropInApprovalSystem::Update (and the ready check client system).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1ADD640 (add helper, size 8) zeroes the u32 at +0; bg3.exe+0x1ADD3A0 (~ per-frame update of ecl::UIManagerProxySystem, step 5/5) copies byte 0 of the queued response; live 1 (probably the answer/button)

fields.name: field_2
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1ADD3A0 copies a u16 at +2; live 1

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1ADD640 initialises +4 to 0xFFFFFFFF; bg3.exe+0x1ADD3A0 assigns it with ls::FixedString::IncRef / GlobalStringTable DecRef (a FixedString, probably the message box id/context); live 0x4E800020

open_questions: meanings of the three small members and of the FixedString (box id vs. context); not read from the reader side
